line.dialogue: The Orders will call this heresy. I don’t want it. I cannot bear this alone. So I ask you, Pichit—how long are you going for? Will you bury it, weaponize it, or trust a broken Order to mend itself? The choice is yours.

lines_before.dialogue: The Hanging Gardens of Mae Rim sway gently in the high-altitude breeze. Terraced fields of luminous sky-rice and whispering barley create a patchwork of greens and golds against the endless crystalline expanse of the Lattice below.
The party rests at a stone overlook. Water channels hum a low, constant tone as they carry irrigation from the city's central cistern.
Finally! A place where the only thing trying to kill us is the boredom. Is the pay good for farm work, you think? We could always retire.
Retire to what? Pulling weeds and listening to the wind? You'd last a day before you tried to jump off the edge just to feel something.
The quiet is… strategic. Good sightlines, predictable patterns. A safe place to regroup and assess our supplies.
It's more than that. Listen. The way the wind moves through the stalks… it has a rhythm. Remember… the old texts called places like this 'the world's breath'.
A local villager, her hands stained with soil, approaches cautiously. She keeps glancing at the Lattice below.

You're the ones who came in on that beat-up resonance ship, yeah? You should keep in mind… the edge gardens aren't as stable as they look. I heard a strange noise last night. From deep below the terraces. A… grinding.

lines_after.dialogue: A grinding noise? Probably just the support crystals settling. Or your stomach after too much barley-bread!
It wasn't settling. It was… hungry. Some of us think the Groundless are right. The city's foundation is singing a dirge. We just don't listen.
Great. So we're resting on a crumbling dinner plate. Charming.

line.dialogue: The villager's fear is palpable, but her information is vague. How to proceed?

choices.line: Comfort her. Assure her it's just natural sounds and offer to check the terrace supports. (Gain local trust, but may miss clues.)
choices.description: Follow the wind's path through the tall grass toward the old stone shrine.

line.dialogue: Pichit — "There. You hear it now? The wind isn't just passing through — it's *calling*. Something remembers this place.
Pichit — "You're listening with your ears. Stop. Listen with your feet. The ground is humming — but you're walking too loud to feel it.

choices.line: Press for specifics. What *exactly* did the noise sound like? Where precisely did it come from? (Risk alarming her, but get better data.)
choices.description: Scan the treeline for threats while the others rest, mapping escape routes.

line.dialogue: Arthit — "Ridge to the north gives us cover if the eastern path is compromised. Three exits, clear sightlines. *This* is why the quiet doesn't scare me.
Arthit — "I counted four gaps in the treeline I can't see into. Quiet doesn't mean safe. It means whatever's watching us hasn't decided yet.

choices.line: Dismiss the concern and focus on your own rest. The gardens have stood for centuries. (Avoid immediate trouble, remain oblivious.)
choices.description: Sit with Malee and ask what she'd actually do if the fighting stopped tomorrow.

line.dialogue: Malee — "I'd find a river that doesn't run red
the villager loses control. The echo fades to silence.

lines_before.dialogue: Following the villager's directions to the lower, older terraces, the air grows cooler. The cheerful sounds of the upper gardens give way to the deep, resonant groan of ancient support spars.
Here, the stonework is cracked. Faint, dissonant vibrations travel up through the soles of your boots. A lone figure in ochre robes—a Listener monk—is on his knees, ear pressed to a fissure.
Proceed with caution. That structural integrity looks compromised. I can't make it back to the ship if this whole shelf gives way!
Don't make me cry! It's just a little crack. Hey, monk! What's the song of the day? A lullaby or a funeral march?
Silence! Can you not hear it? The foundational song… it's fraying. There is a… a silence within the vibration. A void where harmony should be.
A void? Like something is… consuming the resonance?
Or something's digging. The Groundless talk about 'unearthing the truth'. You think they're literalists? Making a u-turn from philosophy to excavation?
The Groundless… they whisper here at night. They say the Tonal Orders' charts are lies, that the true path is *down*, not across. This… this damage… it aligns with their rhetoric.

lines_after.dialogue: The monk stands, his face a mask of conflict. The fissure at his feet seems to pulse with a faint, dark thrum.
My duty is to observe and record the Lattice's natural state. But this… this is unnatural. It is a wound. Do I report it to the Orders and see this place quarantined? Or…
Or do we explore the wound to understand it?

line.dialogue: The monk is torn. The fissure promises dangerous discovery. What do you do?

choices.line: Convince the monk to report it. This is too dangerous to investigate without authority. (Avoid immediate peril, but let the Orders control the narrative.)
choices.description: Arthit presses forward with forbidden paths to use the leg as a lattice probe

line.dialogue: The gamble succeeds. The prosthetic glows with an unfamiliar color.
Arthit is thwarted. Arthit's knowledge proves incomplete.

choices.line: Volunteer to investigate the fissure first. A small, quick look to see what's really down there. (Risk instability, but gain firsthand knowledge.)

line.dialogue: Fortune favors Pichit. His staff pulses with clarity, pointing forward.
Pichit misreads the situation. His staff overheats, forcing him to drop it.

choices.line: Side with the monk's hidden desire. Urge him to hide the discovery and help you explore it fully, defying the Orders. (Forge a secret alliance, invite great risk and greater truth.)
choices.description: Ask the villager to record the spectral signature, drawing on local knowledge

line.dialogue: The lattice answers the villager's call. Local knowledge reveals a detail outsiders would miss.
The lattice has other plans. Terrace-hardened resilience isn't enough.

lines_before.dialogue: The Hanging Gardens are quiet, but not peaceful. The wind carries whispers from the lower terraces where villagers gather. A Listener Monk stands apart, watching the Lattice shimmer below.
Look at them huddled together. They're scared. What did that monk tell them? I'm gonna ask him… straight up.
Wait. We should be careful. The Tonal Orders have ears everywhere. If the Groundless Movement is meeting here…
Oh, wonderful. More rebels. Just what we need. I'm sure their plan to 'return to the ground' involves a lot of poetic dying.
The monk looks troubled. There's a dissonance in his posture. Chanida… I want to ask you something… Do you hear it too? The Lattice's song has changed here.
You approach. I see you Listen. The villagers… they ask questions I cannot answer. About the Silencing. About what truly lies beneath.
He won't tell us! The Orders say the ground is poison, but our grandparents' stories… they don't match. You can ask. You're outsiders. Ask him what the Lattice is really singing down there!

lines_after.dialogue: The monk's eyes dart to the city spires above. The villagers hold their breath. Your question hangs in the air, heavier than the mist from the irrigation channels.
I… I have studied the waveforms. The foundational resonance… it is not a barrier. It is a containment field.
A distant, sharp harmonic chime echoes from the city—a Tonal Order patrol signal. The monk pales.

line.dialogue: The monk has revealed a dangerous truth. The Order's signal means they're coming. The villagers look to you.

choices.text: Hide the monk in the grain silos. Use the crop sounds to mask his resonance.
choices.consequence: Safe, but temporary. The Order will search.
choices.description: Approach the huddled refugees directly and ask what the Tonal Orders did to their village.

line.dialogue: Chanida — "Their voices tremble, but they speak. The Orders burned the temple archives and took three children.
Chanida — "They shrink back from me like I'm wearing the Orders' colors. I've pushed too hard, too fast.

choices.text: Have the monk teach the villagers the 'silent step'—a Listening technique to dampen their sonic presence.
choices.consequence: Empowers them, but risks exposing monastic secrets.
choices.description: Signal Pichit to quietly examine the monk's dissonance while you keep the others talking.

line.dialogue: Pichit — "Someone has severed his harmonic bond. This wasn't natural — it was surgical. The Orders are experimenting on monks.
Pichit — "He catches me studying him and retreats further inward. Whatever is broken in him, he's protecting it.

choices.text: Confront the patrol directly. Use Pichit's innate resonance to create a 'false echo' and mislead them.
choices.consequence: High risk. If successful, creates a diversion. If failed, reveals Pichit is a Singer.
choices.description: Pull Malee aside and demand she drop the sarcasm — these people need medicine, not commentary.

line.dialogue: Malee — "Fine. But when the Orders track these
the villager's resolve isn't enough. Local knowledge proves outdated.

lines_before.dialogue: The Order's patrol ship hovers at the garden's edge, its crystal resonators humming a threatening dominant chord. The villagers are silent. The monk is gone, hidden or fled. The truth is now yours.
They're scanning. They know someone spoke out of tune. Pichit, whatever you're thinking… they mean it. That ship's resonator is tuned for suppression.
Of course they're serious! They have a monopoly on 'truth.' How do you write a history? You erase the original. That's what the Silencing was—a big, loud erasure.
So the ground isn't dead. It's… caged. And they don't want anyone to know! We have to tell them! All of them!
Knowledge is a wave. It needs a medium to travel. If we shout now, the wave breaks against their ship. But if we resonate…
The patrol leader is demanding the 'dissident.' They'll take someone. Could you… could you please write it down for me? What the monk said? So we don't forget?
The patrol ship lowers a ramp. Three Harmonizers in Tonal Order robes step onto the terraces. Their faces are stern masks. The Lattice below seems to vibrate in sympathy with your rising pulse.

By the authority of the Grand Resonance, you will surrender the one who speaks false songs. The Lattice is our protector. To suggest otherwise is to invite a second Silencing. How do you write compliance? You demonstrate the cost of discord.

lines_after.dialogue: The gardens are still. The wind has died. In the silence, a choice becomes a chord that will shatter the peace.
The truth isn't written. It's sung. And today… we choose the song.

line.dialogue: The Order demands a sacrifice. The truth is a weapon. The Groundless Movement watches. What is your final resonance?

choices.text: Offer a distraction. Let the monk escape permanently, taking the blame for 'spreading rumors.' The villagers remain safe, but disillusioned.
choices.consequence: Order satisfied. Movement suppressed. Truth survives, but in exile.
choices.description: Malee presses forward with scavenger instincts to harness harmonic feedback

line.dialogue: Malee pushes through. The prosthetic core makes the lattice temporarily visible.
The resonance turns hostile. The prosthetic's feedback sends a shock up her spine.

choices.text: Challenge the Order's data. Use your party's combined skills to publicly dissect their navigational charts, revealing a deliberate 'silent zone'—proof they are hiding something below.
choices.consequence: Sows widespread doubt. Empowers the Movement. Makes you and the city a permanent target.
choices.description: Have Chanida focus frequency mapping on the agricultural hum to support the rebels

line.dialogue: A breakthrough. A hidden tunnel opens beneath the terraces.
The attempt backfires on Chanida. The singer's gift turns against her.

choices.text: Reveal yourself. Let Pichit Sing—not a navigational tone, but the raw, unedited resonance of the Lattice's base frequency, the 'song of the ground' the Order has silenced.
choices.consequence: Climax. Every Listener in range will hear the truth. Pichit's nature is exposed. The city's relationship to the Lattice is changed irrevocably.
choices.description: The villager takes the lead, employing terraces to decode the distress signal

line.dialogue: The gamble succeeds. Arthit's tattoos warm as the phantom signal strengthens.
The attempt backfires on the villager. The islander's courage breaks.

lines_before.dialogue: The Hollow is a cathedral of echoes. The crystalline lattice walls hum with residual energy, each footstep ringing through the cavern like a struck bell. Strange, shimmering frequencies dance in the air—patterns that refuse to settle into natural harmonics.
lines_before.stage_directions: The air shimmers with visible sound waves. Crystal formations pulse with soft light.

lines_before.dialogue: Don’t think about it too much. Just listen. The lattice isn't chaotic—it's responding. Every echo has intention behind it.
lines_before.stage_directions: Pichit runs his hand along a crystal wall, his resonance staff glowing faintly.

lines_before.dialogue: Look at this! The resonance patterns—they're too symmetrical. Like someone tuned this place. Don’t get so stressed out, Malee, this is amazing!
lines_before.stage_directions: Chanida points excitedly at her frequency scanner, her movements animated.

lines_before.dialogue: Amazing? Or dangerous. The Tonal Orders would charge a fortune for this kind of mapping data. I just spoke with the resonance scanner—it's picking up structures beneath us. Ancient ones.
lines_before.stage_directions: Malee checks her equipment, her expression skeptical.

lines_before.dialogue: Stay alert. These frequencies—they feel like keys. If the lattice is responding to specific tones... Just relax, but keep your guard up. This place remembers something.
lines_before.stage_directions: Arthit positions himself between the party and the darker passages, hand on his resonator.

lines_before.dialogue: Arthit's careful strike with a precisely calibrated frequency sends a shiver through the western wall. Crystal dissolves into shimmering mist, revealing a passage that hasn't seen light since before The Silencing.
lines_before.stage_directions: The wall becomes translucent, then vanishes, revealing carved stone steps descending into darkness.

lines_before.dialogue: Murals! These aren't navigation charts—they're... weapons? Arrays for projecting sound across continents. Don’t judge others, but our ancestors weren't just traveling. They were broadcasting.
lines_before.stage_directions: Chanida traces the ancient carvings with awe, her scanner whirring.

lines_before.dialogue: What are you doing in our sacred place? Outsiders! You'll anger the echoes!
lines_before.stage_directions: A group of skycity residents appears at the chamber entrance, led by a fearful elder clutching a simple resonator.

lines_before.dialogue: Now, now, let's all just relax. I'm sure our scholarly friends mean no harm. Though... I don't think so simple a survey would reveal such impressive ruins. What fascinating leverage one might find here.
lines_before.stage_directions: The merchant steps forward with a smooth smile, but his eyes dart across the murals, calculating.

lines_after.dialogue: The chamber falls silent except for the hum of ancient crystal. The villagers' fear and the merchant's greed hang in the air like dissonant chords.
lines_after.stage_directions: The murals seem to pulse with latent energy. Dust motes dance in stray light beams.

lines_after.dialogue: This changes everything. The Silencing wasn't an accident. They knew how to weaponize sound.
lines_after.stage_directions: Pichit's staff pulses in time with his racing thoughts, casting shifting shadows.

lines_after.dialogue: You must leave! This place is forbidden! The lattice remembers the old screams!
lines_after.stage_directions: The elder steps forward, resonator raised defensively.

lines_after.dialogue: We can't stop now! There's more down that passage—archives, maybe! The truth is right there!
lines_after.stage_directions: Chanida points toward the newly revealed deeper tunnel, already taking a step toward it.

line.dialogue: The dilemma: Pichit must decide whether to aggressively pursue the investigation in front of the nervous locals and the merchant, or to downplay their discovery and try to buy time.
line.stage_directions: The merchant's smile doesn't reach his eyes as he watches Pichit's reaction.

choices.description: Press your palm flat against the central crystal and let the resonance flow through you unfiltered.

line.dialogue: Pichit — "I can feel the pattern now—it's not random, it's a language, and I think it's... introducing itself.
Pichit — "No—no, that's too much, it's pouring in faster than I can—I need to pull back before it rewires something I can't undo.

choices.description: Trace the asymmetrical fracture line Chanida noticed and follow it to where the pattern breaks its own rules.

line.dialogue: Chanida — "Here—the symmetry fails on purpose! This defect is a signature, someone *designed* this to be findable by people who look closely.
Chanida — "I thought I had it but the fracture just... doubles back on itself. I'm reading my own reflection in the geometry.

choices.description: Hum the counter-frequency Arthit sensed and watch how the lattice responds to a living voice woven into its structure.

line.dialogue: Arthit — "It's answering—the whole lattice just shifted a quarter-tone toward me. We're not observing this place, we're *being auditioned.*
Arthit — "Wrong pitch.

lines_before.dialogue: The final seal dissolves with a sigh of crystallized air. Beyond the vault door lies a vast circular chamber, its walls faceted like a geode. In the center, a column of pure quartz hums with latent energy. The air itself seems thick with suspended whispers.
lines_before.stage_directions: The chamber is illuminated by the column's soft blue light. Ghostly afterimages of sound—fractured echoes—drift like dust motes.

lines_before.dialogue: It's like the room went to bed late last night and never woke up. These whispers... they're not random. They're waiting to be understood.
lines_before.stage_directions: Pichit runs a hand over a wall, feeling the faint vibration. His staff's crystal pulses in sympathy.

lines_before.dialogue: Remarkable preservation! Look at the crystal latticework on these data-stacks. Untouched for generations. The historical value alone...
lines_before.stage_directions: He immediately begins examining the nearest artifacts, his eyes calculating, fingers brushing surfaces to gauge quality.

lines_before.dialogue: Forget the treasure! That central column—it's the heart of this place. I can feel it humming in my bones. Let's wake it up!
lines_before.stage_directions: She strides toward the column, her own resonator crystals chiming softly in her satchel.

lines_before.dialogue: Easy. This isn't a festival bell. One wrong frequency and we might be the ones who are sorry for disturbing it. Let Pichit read the room first.
lines_before.stage_directions: She scans the perimeter, checking for structural weaknesses or hidden mechanisms, her expression skeptical.

lines_before.dialogue: The air tastes of old sorrow. Stand ready. We don't know what memories are locked in that stone.
lines_before.stage_directions: He positions himself between the party and the column, hand resting on his weapon's hilt, muscles tense.

lines_before.dialogue: At Chanida's touch, the central column flares. Light spills upward, coalescing into shimmering holograms that fill the chamber's dome. Figures in ancient uniforms move with frantic purpose. The images are logs—the final records.
lines_before.stage_directions: The holograms show a control room of sleek, alien design. Technicians scramble around massive resonators. The label 'Project Bastion' flashes.

lines_after.dialogue: The holograms collapse. The last echo of the shattering world fades into a profound, aching silence. The column's light dims to a mournful glow.
lines_after.stage_directions: The floating dust of light settles. The resident has sunk to their knees. The merchant's smile is gone.

lines_after.dialogue: We were all late to understand. The Listeners weren't mystics hearing ghosts. They were doctors listening to a wound that never healed.
lines_after.stage_directions: Pichit looks from his grief-stricken staff to the weeping villager, his own resolve hardening. The truth is a burden, but it's theirs now.

lines_after.dialogue: My great-grandsire... his face. His regret. It's in our blood. What do we do with this? The whole sky is built on his 'I'm sorry'.
lines_after.stage_directions: The villager looks up, eyes red-rimmed, searching Pichit's face for an answer, a way to bear this new, terrible inheritance.

lines_after.dialogue: We don't bury it again! That's what they did. Look where it got us. The archive isn't finished. There has to be more—why they did it, how to fix it!
lines_after.stage_directions: She's already at the column, her hands pressing against it, trying to coax another response, driven by furious purpose.

line.dialogue: The dilemma: Pichit must decide how to respond to the Resident's grief and guilt. Offer comforting lies about the past being done, or force a painful reconciliation with the truth?
line.stage_directions: The merchant watches Pichit closely, his own expression unreadable, a ledger of risk and profit being calculated behind his eyes.

choices.description: Arthit steps forward with forbidden paths, ready to question the Orders' silence

line.dialogue: Arthit succeeds. His tattooed routes warm, revealing a path through chaos.
Arthit hits a wall. A Tonal Order enforcer confiscates the crystal.

line.dialogue: Victory, for now. Pichit's staff vibrates, revealing the lattice's song has changed.
A costly mistake by Chanida. Her voice cracks from the overwhelming frequency.

lines_before.dialogue: The archive's central chamber hums with crystalline light. Schematics float in the air, etched in hard light—blueprints for the weapon that ended the world.
lines_before.stage_directions: The walls are lined with dormant resonator crystals. The air smells of ozone and dust.

lines_before.dialogue: The price is the same. Silence or revelation, someone pays.
lines_before.stage_directions: He traces a finger over a floating schematic. It shivers.

lines_before.dialogue: The anomalous frequencies we tracked... they're not natural. They're scars. Residual echoes from the Scouring Array's firing. The Lattice itself is still wounded.
lines_before.stage_directions: She holds a resonator crystal to her ear, face pale.

lines_before.dialogue: Fascinating, isn't it? Knowledge with a body count. I can be of service. I can smuggle key artifacts out for you to study in secret. Or... I can help you bury this place forever. Seal it under a mountain of silence.
lines_before.stage_directions: He leans against a console, smiling a thin, professional smile.

lines_before.dialogue: We have a duty. The Silencing wasn't an accident—it was a crime. The people deserve to know what their civilization is built upon!
lines_before.stage_directions: His fists are clenched, voice tight with conviction.

lines_before.dialogue: And then what? Panic? The Floating Cities turning on each other, blaming each other for a war their ancestors forgot? You think you're the good guys for telling? Maybe. But you, too, will have blood on your hands if the cities fall again.
lines_before.stage_directions: She steps between Arthit and the schematics, protective.

lines_before.dialogue: The Trade Negotiator watches the argument like a spectator at a particularly interesting match. His gaze settles on Pichit.
lines_before.stage_directions: The hum of the archive seems to grow louder, more insistent.

lines_after.dialogue: The weight of the choice hangs in the air, thick as the dust. The merchant's smile doesn't waver.
lines_after.stage_directions: Crystals pulse in time with Pichit's heartbeat.

lines_after.dialogue: It's really worth seeing... the truth. But at what cost?
lines_after.stage_directions: He looks from Arthit's fervor to Chanida's fear. His staff pulses with a soft, anxious light.

lines_after.dialogue: I was bad! I'm a bad guy for wanting to keep my family safe? For not wanting the sky to fall? You think you're holding a secret. You're holding a lit fuse.
lines_after.stage_directions: The Skycity Resident's voice is raw, stripped of earlier guilt, now purely defensive.

lines_after.dialogue: Well? The price is the same. Which debt do we want to owe?
lines_after.stage_directions: She crosses her arms, waiting. The path forward forks here, in the dark.

line.dialogue: The dilemma: Pichit must make a preliminary choice: side with Arthit's call for transparency or Chanida's caution, thereby deciding whether to begin securing the archive for future study or for permanent sealing.
line.stage_directions: He produces a small, intricate key from his sleeve. It glints in the crystal light.

the villager is thwarted. The monastery's countermeasures activate.

lines_before.dialogue: The ancient chamber groans. Deep within the crystal walls, the lattice scars uncovered by the party begin to pulse with a sickly, violet light. The very air vibrates with remembered agony.
lines_before.stage_directions: Dust rains from the ceiling. The archive's crystal pillars flicker erratically.

lines_before.dialogue: Knowledge, once uncovered, cannot be controlled—only acted upon. That's all, isn't it? We woke this pain up. Now we have to answer for it.
lines_before.stage_directions: He braces himself against a shuddering console, his face etched with exhaustion and resolve.

lines_before.dialogue: The lattice remembers the pain! It's resonating with the scars—the frequency from the Silencing! We have to do something NOW!
lines_before.stage_directions: She points frantically as hairline fractures spiderweb across the floor.

lines_before.dialogue: Our ship's emitter is still tethered topside. We can use it. Two options: cancel the frequency and bury this place forever, or... amplify it. Redirect the whole screaming history of the Silencing into that central column.
lines_before.stage_directions: She taps a cracked crystal display, running frantic calculations.

lines_before.dialogue: Amplify it? Are you insane? That could shatter the entire island's core!
lines_before.stage_directions: He shields his face as a chunk of crystal shatters nearby.

lines_before.dialogue: Roll up your sleeves. I'm not watching this place fall apart. You showed me the truth. Now let's do something with it.
lines_before.stage_directions: The Skycity Resident grunts, using a pry-bar to clear fallen debris from a critical console.

lines_before.dialogue: Fascinating. A controlled collapse versus a permanent, harmonic record. The market implications for either outcome... it's something to think about. I'm on my way out to a safer vantage point. Do send word of the result.
lines_before.stage_directions: The Trade Negotiator gives a thin, clinical smile, already backing toward an exit, a recording crystal glowing softly in his hand.

lines_before.dialogue: The ground lurches. The violent resonance builds toward a crescendo. The choice is no longer theoretical—it must be made, and the emitter configured, in the next few minutes before The Hollow tears itself apart.
lines_before.stage_directions: The central crystal column begins to hum, absorbing the chaotic energy. A deep, sorrowful tone fills the chamber.

lines_after.dialogue: The chamber falls still. Not silent—a new, profound harmony resonates from the island's heart, a stable song woven from a scream.
lines_after.stage_directions: The violent cracks have sealed with solidified light. The archive's data now pulses gently within the central column.

lines_after.dialogue: We didn't bury it. We gave it a voice. A better one. You need to love yourself enough to face the past, not hide from it.
lines_after.stage_directions: He leans heavily on his staff, which now pulses in time with the column's new, gentle rhythm.

lines_after.dialogue: That sound... it's in the stone now. Anyone who listens will find it. The Tonal Orders can't chart this. What do we do?
lines_after.stage_directions: They look from Pichit to the exit, the weight of complicity dawning on them.

lines_after.dialogue: We move. That merchant's already gone to sell his story. The truth is out of the box. We have to be the ones to shape what happens next!
lines_after.stage_directions: She grabs her pack, eyes blazing with determined energy, already heading for the passage out.

line.dialogue: Your move, archivist. Seal the wound and let the world sleep, or sing the scar into the world's memory and live with the echo? My report awaits your signature.
line.stage_directions: His voice crackles over a comm-crystal from his 'safe distance', calm and mercenary.

line.dialogue: The lattice is exhaling—it's letting go of every wound it ever absorbed.
Feedback loop! The emitter's choking on its own signal—we're poisoning the lattice worse!

choices.description: Crawl into the lattice core and harmonize your own heartbeat to its resonance pattern. 15 words

line.dialogue: I can feel them—every voice the lattice recorded—I'm singing them home.
Too many frequencies—I can't hold my own rhythm—it's swallowing me whole!

lines_before.dialogue: The observation platform hangs suspended above the crystalline sea, a fragile cage of iron and glass bolted to a stable spire. Below, the Lattice shimmers with captured light, a thousand fractured rainbows dancing across geometric planes that stretch to the horizon.
lines_before.stage_directions: The air hums with residual resonance. Wind whistles through the platform's metal framework.

lines_before.dialogue: There it is... the anomaly sector Aroon mentioned. I'm interested in how something so deliberate could create such chaos. The patterns aren't natural—they're purposeful.
lines_before.stage_directions: Pichit leans against the glass, staff glowing faintly as it resonates with the lattice below.

lines_before.dialogue: That's it! That shimmering patch to the northeast. My teams won't go near it. The harmonics are all wrong—makes your teeth ache. He's only interested in causing trouble, whoever's doing this.
lines_before.stage_directions: Aroon points with a calloused hand, his face etched with practical fear.

lines_before.dialogue: Wait—movement! Down there, near the crimson crystal cluster! Someone's planting something!
lines_before.stage_directions: Chanida presses against the glass, nearly fogging it with her breath.

lines_before.dialogue: Sky pirate markings on his gear. Krit, if the bounty posters are accurate. But he's moving... wrong. That limp isn't tactical.
lines_before.stage_directions: Malee squints, adjusting her ocular lens.

lines_before.dialogue: Careful! The whole platform's vibrating. Lift it carefully with your perception—don't let the resonance overwhelm you.
lines_before.stage_directions: Arthit places a steadying hand on Pichit's shoulder as a low hum builds.

lines_before.dialogue: The hum deepens into a painful frequency. Below, Krit collapses, clutching his leg—which glows with mismatched crystal light—before scrambling into a crevice.
lines_before.stage_directions: Glass panels rattle in their frames. The anomalous sector pulses angrily.

lines_after.dialogue: Silence returns, heavier than before. The lattice settles, but the memory of that pained frequency lingers in the bones.
lines_after.stage_directions: Fractured light slowly returns to normal patterns.

lines_after.dialogue: Thank you for your concern, Arthit. But that wasn't just sabotage—that was agony turned into resonance. He's not just planting shards; he's crying out.
lines_after.stage_directions: Pichit's staff pulses in sympathy with the fading echo.

lines_after.dialogue: You're gonna be sorry for chasing after him. Pirates like Krit don't care who gets hurt. But... the Tonal Order outpost would pay well for his location.
lines_after.stage_directions: Aroon backs toward the lift, conflicted between fear and opportunity.

lines_after.dialogue: He's injured and alone! There she is—the crevice he vanished into. We could reach it before the Order even mobilizes!
lines_after.stage_directions: Chanida already has her hand on the descent winch.

line.dialogue: The dilemma: Pichit must decide: follow Krit immediately into the dangerous lattice field, or heed Aroon's warning and report the sighting to the (untrusted) local Tonal Order outpost?
line.stage_directions: The platform creaks. Distant resonance ships drift like ghosts.

choices.description: Drop behind the ridge and observe the pirate through the scope of your crystal rifle.

line.dialogue: He's running a survey pattern—amateur hour. I can pick off his comm beacon without him ever knowing.
Damn—my scope caught sunlight on the lens. He's looking right at us. Everyone down, NOW.

choices.description: Send Chanida circling west to flank while you and Malee approach openly as traders.

line.dialogue: I'm in position behind the cluster. If he reaches for a weapon, I'll have his spine before his fingers touch leather.
Loose shale under my boots—he spun around. The flank's blown, but I can still close the gap if you need me to.

choices.description: Signal Malee to fire a warning shot above the pirate's head and demand he freeze.

line.dialogue: He dropped flat and raised both hands. Sky pirate or not, nobody wants to die for someone else's cargo.
Warning shot went wide—ricochet off the crystal cluster and now he's scrambling for cover behind the eastern outcropping!

lines_before.dialogue: The air in the shimmering sector hums with a dissonant energy. Light fractures into jagged rainbows across crystalline planes, while sound feels heavy and muffled—as if the very air has thickened.
lines_before.stage_directions: The party moves cautiously across unstable, glassy ground that shifts with a low groan.

lines_before.dialogue: I heard a strange noise earlier—like a crystal cracking underwater. It's not a problem, just... unsettling. This place feels wounded.
lines_before.stage_directions: He taps his staff against the lattice; the resonance returns distorted and weak.

lines_before.dialogue: There! A fracture in the surface—deep enough to hide a camp. You've arrived? Come on out, saboteur!
lines_before.stage_directions: She points her blade toward a dark crevice, her stance ready.

lines_before.dialogue: Scavenged tech, harmonic charts scattered like leaves. This isn't a military outpost. It's a workshop.
lines_before.stage_directions: She kneels, examining a half-assembled resonator coil.

lines_before.dialogue: Stay sharp. Aroon's warning repeats in my ear—'He's dangerous.' But this clutter... it tells a different story.
lines_before.stage_directions: He keeps his shield raised, eyes scanning the high crystal ledges.

lines_before.dialogue: At the heart of the camp, a crude metal frame is grafted to a pulsing, raw crystal. It glows with a sickly light, leaking harmonic energy that warps the air around it.
lines_before.stage_directions: The prosthetic leg thrums irregularly, casting jagged shadows.

lines_before.dialogue: That's no problem!
lines_before.stage_directions: Krit drops from an overhead crystal spar, landing with a pained stagger. He brandishes a frequency disruptor, its prongs buzzing.

lines_before.dialogue: But my leg... it's starting to... growl!
lines_before.stage_directions: He winces as the prosthetic emits a deep, painful thrum that vibrates through the ground.

lines_before.dialogue: You're the one causing the lattice quakes? For what? Scrap metal?
lines_before.stage_directions: She steps forward, blade humming with defensive resonance.

lines_before.dialogue: Sabotage? I'm trying to live! Lost the real one in a raid, cobbled this together. It's tuned wrong—bleeds resonance every time I move. Your 'anomalies' are just my bad luck.
lines_before.stage_directions: His aggressive stance falters as another pulse of pain shoots through the prosthetic.

lines_before.dialogue: He's telling the truth. Look at the graft—it's fused to the bone. No one would choose this. The frequency charts here... they're correctional. He's been trying to fix it.
lines_before.stage_directions: She doesn't lower her weapon, but her voice loses its edge.

lines_before.dialogue: Aroon is still in my ear, demanding capture. But if we fight him here, on this unstable ground, with that thing leaking energy...
lines_before.stage_directions: He glances at Pichit, leaving the decision unspoken.

lines_after.dialogue: The standoff hangs in the muffled air. Krit's disruptor wavers between threat and desperate prop. The prosthetic pulses like a sick heart.
lines_after.stage_directions: Shadows stretch and contract with each erratic thrum.

lines_after.dialogue: I believe you can do it—fix this, I mean. But not alone. And not by bleeding resonance across the lattice.
lines_after.stage_directions: His staff's crystal glows softly, reflecting the prosthetic's light.

lines_after.dialogue: Aroon's voice crackles over the comms: 'The bounty is guaranteed if you bring him in. The Tonal Orders want this resolved. Now.'
lines_after.stage_directions: The transmission is sharp, full of static from the lattice interference.

lines_after.dialogue: So? What's the call, Pichit? Do we collect the reward or collect a project?
lines_after.stage_directions: She hasn't sheathed her blade, but her eyes are on the malfunctioning leg, not the man.

line.dialogue: The dilemma: Pichit must decide: fight and capture Krit for the bounty/report, or believe his story and offer to help him fix the prosthetic?
line.stage_directions: Krit's eyes dart between the party and his throbbing leg, a cornered animal weighing fight or flight.

choices.description: Chanida channels unauthorized tones toward the harvesting, hoping to test the prosthetic reaction

line.dialogue: Chanida pushes through. Malee's leg locks onto a buried harmonic node.
Chanida's resolve isn't enough. The prosthetic's feedback sends a painful shock.

choices.description: Ask Malee to use the leg as a lattice probe, drawing on leg resonance

line.dialogue: Exactly as Malee hoped. The crystal core makes the lattice temporarily visible.
Malee's resolve isn't enough. A harmonic mismatch causes malfunction.

choices.description: Convince the villager to use community ties and test the prosthetic reaction

line.dialogue: A breakthrough. Local knowledge reveals a detail outsiders would miss.
the villager hits a wall. The islander's courage breaks.

lines_before.dialogue: The lattice's surface hummed with a low, anxious frequency. The crystalline expanse stretched out beneath the party, its usual serene glow now fractured by Krit's unstable prosthetic.
lines_before.stage_directions: The lattice's light pulsed irregularly, like a wounded heart.

lines_before.dialogue: The resonance is wrong. It feels like a scream trapped in glass.
lines_before.stage_directions: He touches the lattice with his staff, feeling the vibrations.

lines_before.dialogue: The Tonal Order depot has what we need. A Harmonic Dampener. Stealing it... it's the best way.
lines_before.stage_directions: Krit's eyes are sharp, calculating. His pirate cunning is clear.

lines_before.dialogue: Stealing from the Order? Are you insane?
lines_before.stage_directions: She gestures wildly towards the distant floating city.

lines_before.dialogue: Scouting from the overlook, I analyzed the security. There's a high chance we can bypass the outer harmonics if we use the lattice's own resonance at dusk.
lines_before.stage_directions: She checks a small frequency scanner.

lines_before.dialogue: This is reckless. We're not thieves.
lines_before.stage_directions: He stands protectively near Pichit, hand on his weapon.

lines_before.dialogue: A sudden, panicked frequency buzzes through Pichit's communication crystal. Aroon's voice crackles.
lines_before.stage_directions: The crystal glows with urgent, red light.

lines_after.dialogue: Aroon's frequency cut out, leaving only the ominous, growing hum of approaching enforcement resonators.
lines_after.stage_directions: The lattice vibrates with the distant, organized thrum of Order ships.

lines_after.dialogue: Now I know why you stayed out here. You're helping him.
lines_after.stage_directions: He repeats Aroon's words, understanding the gravity.

lines_after.dialogue: The enforcers are mobilizing. I'm on my way out. I can't be caught here!
lines_after.stage_directions: A nearby lattice farmer hastily packs his tools, fear palpable.

lines_after.dialogue: One way or round trip? This decision feels final.
lines_after.stage_directions: She looks at Pichit, waiting for his lead.

line.dialogue: The depot's at the city's edge. My lattice knowledge gets us in. Their dampener gets me stable. Or you can hand me over and watch the lattice shatter. Your choice.
line.stage_directions: Krit's prosthetic flares dangerously, emphasizing the threat.

choices.description: Scale the eastern wall at midnight when the resonant wards cycle down for recalibration.

line.dialogue: The wards flickered and died — I slipped over the wall like silence itself," Malee whispers.
The wards fired early — harmonic force slammed me off the wall and into the gravel," Malee hisses, clutching her ribs.

choices.description: Forge Order vestments and walk through the front gate during shift change, hiding in plain sight.

line.dialogue: They saw the robes, not our faces — we walked through like we belonged," Bandit says, adjusting his stolen collar.
The sergeant demanded our tone-codes — one wrong syllable and the whole depot screamed," Chanida mutters, ears still ringing.

choices.description: Collapse the drainage culvert beneath the depot to breach the lower vault directly.

line.dialogue: Old stone, older pipes — one charge and the floor swallowed us right into the vault," Pichit says, brushing dust from his shoulders.
The culvert was reinforced — the charge blew back and buried us in half a ton of rubble," Pichit coughs through the smoke.

lines_before.dialogue: The lattice surface beneath your boots thrums with a dangerous, rising whine. Crystalline spikes around the depot platform vibrate at a frequency that makes your teeth ache. In the distance, the dark silhouettes of Tonal Order enforcers' resonance ships converge like hunting birds.
lines_before.stage_directions: The sky is a bruised purple, lit by the lattice's internal glow. The prosthetic leg emits visible harmonic distortion waves.

lines_before.dialogue: We have to do better than this. A man shouldn't have to scream just to walk.
lines_before.stage_directions: He grips his staff, its crystal tip pulsing in sympathy with the unstable resonance.

lines_before.dialogue: Don't leave it on! The feedback loop will shatter the crystal!
lines_before.stage_directions: Krit braces against the depot wall, face pale with pain as Malee works on his leg. His eyes are fixed on the dampener module.

lines_before.dialogue: Easy for you to say—you're not the one trying to install this while lattice enforcers are closing in!
lines_before.stage_directions: She keeps glancing at the approaching ships, fingers twitching toward her weapon.

lines_before.dialogue: The dampener's aligned. One more adjustment... there. Feedback stabilized.
lines_before.stage_directions: She wipes crystal dust from her hands, watching as the painful resonance ceases. The lattice around them falls silent.

lines_before.dialogue: They're hailing us. Demanding surrender. Better if you don't go with him, Krit. They might show leniency.
lines_before.stage_directions: He stands between Krit and the approaching ships, shield raised.

lines_before.dialogue: The silence that follows is profound. For the first time since you met him, Krit stands steady, the lattice calm beneath his feet. He looks at each of you, then down at his now-quiet prosthetic.
lines_before.stage_directions: Krit takes an experimental step. No whine, no distortion. Just the quiet hum of stable resonance.

lines_after.dialogue: Krit reaches into his coat and pulls out a set of frequency charts etched on thin crystal sheets. They glow with forbidden harmonics.
lines_after.stage_directions: The charts show lattice routes unknown to the Tonal Orders. Krit holds them out.

lines_after.dialogue: You made me feel better. But I don't want people knowing where I'm headed next.
lines_after.stage_directions: Krit's voice is quiet, sincere. This is his version of payment—and his version of goodbye.

lines_after.dialogue: Aroon's watching from the platform edge. He won't meet your eyes—too afraid of being implicated. But he gives a slight nod of relief that the anomalies have ceased.
lines_after.stage_directions: Aroon backs away slowly, disappearing into the depot shadows.

lines_after.dialogue: They're closing fast. Decide, Pichit!
lines_after.stage_directions: She points at the enforcer ships now visible in detail—gleaming hulls marked with Tonal Order sigils.

line.dialogue: The dilemma: Pichit's final choice: Accept Krit's charts and let him escape into the lattice, honoring his secrecy? Or insist he turn himself in, hoping for leniency given the circumstances?
line.stage_directions: Krit holds the charts in one hand, his other resting on his newly-stabilized leg. The enforcer ships' resonance fields begin to part the lattice around the depot.

choices.description: Hold the dampener's housing steady while Malee makes the final calibration adjustment.

line.dialogue: That's it—the resonance is holding. Whoever you're trying to protect, he's got a chance now.
It slipped! The housing rotated fifteen degrees and now we're back to square one.

choices.description: Disconnect the feedback loop manually before the crystal shatters, trusting Bandit's warning.

line.dialogue: Quick hands! You pulled the relay just before it cascaded. I've seen seasoned engineers freeze at that moment.
Too slow—the loop peaked. Crystal's cracked clean through. Hope someone brought a spare, because that one's done.

choices.description: Take over the installation from Chanida yourself, citing your steadier hands under pressure.

line.dialogue: Fine. You do it. But if you scratch that mounting plate, I swear I'll make you file the replacement by hand.
I knew I should've kept going myself. Now the contact pins are bent and we need the extraction tool from the shuttle.

lines_before.dialogue: The lower deck of the resonance ship hummed with the vessel's own crystal-driven heartbeat. Shadows pooled between crates of salvaged lattice fragments, and the air tasted of ozone and dust.
lines_before.stage_directions: Dim light from flickering crystal sconces. The air vibrates faintly.

lines_before.dialogue: A crewmate introduced us. Said they knew someone who could help with our questions about the strange frequencies. But down here, trust feels thinner than the hull plating.
lines_before.stage_directions: Grips his staff, senses alert.

lines_before.dialogue: Peace upon your path. My contact said you seek understanding of the Lattice's new dissonance. Please, could you speak more slowly? My studies have left my ears... fatigued.
lines_before.stage_directions: Kneels by a small, intricate apparatus, ear pressed to a listening horn aimed at the deck.

lines_before.dialogue: New dissonance? What's it sound like? Is it dangerous?
lines_before.stage_directions: Leans in, practically vibrating with curiosity.

lines_before.dialogue: Everything down here is dangerous. Especially monks who work in shadows.
lines_before.stage_directions: Eyes scanning the cluttered bay, hand resting on a tool at her belt.

lines_before.dialogue: Easy. He's studying a frequency, not plotting a mutiny.
lines_before.stage_directions: Stands guard near the doorway, tense.

lines_before.dialogue: The monk's apparatus began to emit a faint, discordant hum, a sound that seemed to grate against the ship's own resonance.
lines_before.stage_directions: The apparatus glows with an unhealthy violet light. A nearby crate vibrates.

lines_after.dialogue: The silence that followed was louder than the crash. Dust motes danced in the light from the broken locker door.
lines_after.stage_directions: A jagged piece of crystal from the prosthetic glints on the floor.

lines_after.dialogue: Her leg... it resonates with the same wrong note. This isn't heresy. It's a clue.
lines_after.stage_directions: His own staff pulses once in sympathetic resonance.

lines_after.dialogue: Please... I didn't steal it! I found it! In the old ruins, where the Lattice sings a dead song. No one wants to go there, but I had to!
lines_after.stage_directions: Voice trembling but defiant, clutching her humming leg.

lines_after.dialogue: A dead song? That's where we need to be! Come on, Pichit, we have to hear this!
lines_after.stage_directions: Already moving toward the scavenger, ignoring the furious monk.

line.dialogue: You see? This abomination vibrates with the corruption! By the edicts of the Tonal Orders, she must be detained and the prosthetic destroyed! Or will you shield a heretic and risk a cascade that could shatter this ship?
line.stage_directions: Points an accusing, trembling finger. His calm scholar's demeanor is gone, replaced by rigid dogma.

choices.description: Pull out your recording device and ask Chanida to describe the dissonance in detail, 15 words

line.dialogue: It hums at a frequency that makes your teeth ache — like the crystals are arguing with themselves.
I'm not your research subject. Ask nicely or don't ask at all.

choices.description: Step between Malee and the monk, demanding they both lower their weapons and hands, 15 words

line.dialogue: Fine. But if those robes start glowing, I'm putting a bolt through them. No offense, holy man.
You don't give me orders, stranger. I knew this monk before you crawled down here.

choices.description: Address the monk directly — ask what they know about the dissonance beneath the crystal fields, 15 words

line.dialogue: The song beneath the stones is old. Older than language. I can teach you to hear it — if you're ready.
You ask with urgency, not respect. The dissonance will not reveal itself to those who grasp at it.

lines_before.dialogue: The hum of the ship's resonator faded to a whisper as Kirin's scream cut through the engineering bay. She collapsed against a crystal conduit, her prosthetic leg emitting a sharp, shrieking resonance that made the nearby lattice fragments vibrate violently.
lines_before.stage_directions: The air shimmers with painful harmonics. Kirin's face is pale, sweat beading on her forehead.

lines_before.dialogue: You look run down. Aren't you tired? This pain... it's more than mechanical.
lines_before.stage_directions: Kneeling beside Kirin, his hands hovering over the malfunctioning prosthetic without touching it.

lines_before.dialogue: This is... fascinating. And horrifying. The resonance pattern matches pre-Silencing harmonics. I'll have a look. For scholarly purposes, of course.
lines_before.stage_directions: His hands tremble as he examines the prosthetic from a careful distance, dogmatism warring with genuine scientific curiosity.

lines_before.dialogue: Stop gawking and help! Can't you see she's dying?
lines_before.stage_directions: Already tearing open a maintenance panel, looking for tools.

lines_before.dialogue: The ship's resonator could stabilize it. Or cook her nervous system. Your call, Pichit.
lines_before.stage_directions: Tapping the main console, calculating risks with a cynical frown.

lines_before.dialogue: Quiet. The crew will hear that shrieking. We need to muffle it or move her.
lines_before.stage_directions: Eyes darting to the door, one hand on his weapon.

lines_before.dialogue: As Arthit wedges a sound-dampening blanket against the door, Kirin's breathing becomes ragged. The prosthetic's crystalline surface flickers with sickly light.
lines_before.stage_directions: The light pulses in time with Kirin's shallow breaths.

lines_after.dialogue: The temporary patch holds, but barely. Kirin's color returns slowly, though her eyes remain clouded with pain and memory.
lines_after.stage_directions: The prosthetic hums at a lower, steadier frequency, but occasional sparks still dance across its surface.

lines_after.dialogue: It makes you look younger when you're not fighting for every breath. Tell us about the silent zone. The machine that did this.
lines_after.stage_directions: His staff pulses with soft light as he maintains the stabilizing field.

lines_after.dialogue: Wasn't... found. Was grafted. To save me. The machine... it's still there. In the place where the lattice doesn't sing back.
lines_after.stage_directions: Her voice is weak but clearer now, the defensive facade completely gone.

lines_after.dialogue: A place the lattice doesn't respond? That's impossible! The Orders say—
lines_after.stage_directions: Cut off by her own realization, already moving toward the navigation console.

line.dialogue: The patch is failing. Her vital signs are dropping again. Pichit, you must decide: do we attempt a full, risky recalibration using the ship's main resonator—which could alert the entire crew to this heresy—or perform another temporary patch that will leave her weak and the prosthetic unstable?
line.stage_directions: The monk's eyes are wide with both fear and fascination, his hands still trembling.

choices.description: Convince Arthit to use ship navigation and test the prosthetic reaction

line.dialogue: The gamble succeeds. The crystal core makes the lattice temporarily visible.
Arthit overreaches. The ex-captain's gamble costs dearly.

choices.description: Malee attempts to harness harmonic feedback, relying on engineering

line.dialogue: Malee's expertise pays off. Her prosthetic locks onto a buried harmonic node.
Things don't go as planned. The lattice frequency overwhelms the core.

choices.description: The monk presses forward with lattice study to tune the prosthetic

line.dialogue: The risk was worth it. The prosthetic glows with an unfamiliar color.
The gamble fails. His recording crystal shatters.

lines_before.dialogue: The ship groans like a wounded beast. Through the crystalflex viewports, the Lattice below churns in violent, discordant waves, its usual harmonic shimmer replaced by jagged, angry fractures of light. The air smells of ozone and panic.
lines_before.stage_directions: The ship lurches violently. Emergency runes flash amber along the corridors.

lines_before.dialogue: I have an uneasy feeling. That surge... it felt wrong. Like we woke something up.
lines_before.stage_directions: Pichit braces against a shuddering bulkhead, his staff glowing erratically.

lines_before.dialogue: The ship's core resonates with the disturbance! The First Mate will be upon us. The Tonal Orders do not tolerate unsanctioned frequencies.
lines_before.stage_directions: The monk's hands tremble, pressed to the vibrating wall as if listening.

lines_before.dialogue: Well, it's not a problem! We just explain! Or... fight. Fighting works.
lines_before.stage_directions: Chanida draws her short blades, her eyes wide with adrenaline rather than fear.

lines_before.dialogue: Explain? With armed crew coming? My stomach is starting to growl from all this stress, but we have bigger issues. Listen.
lines_before.stage_directions: Malee cocks her head, hearing the thud of boots on the deck above. She checks her gear.

lines_before.dialogue: Stay behind me. We're committed now. There's something in my eye from this damned crystal dust, but I can still see trouble coming.
lines_before.stage_directions: Arthit steps in front of Pichit, shield raised, blinking rapidly.

lines_before.dialogue: The door to the engineering bay slams open. The First Mate stands framed in the doorway, four armed resonators at her back. Her gaze falls on Kirin, whose prosthetic leg is now sparking with wild, chaotic light.
lines_before.stage_directions: Kirin grits her teeth, clutching her searing leg. The First Mate's expression is cold fury.

lines_after.dialogue: The chase ends at the storm-lashed main deck. Rain lashes horizontally. Kirin, collapsed against the ship's rail, shouts a string of numbers and bearings into the gale—coordinates burned into her memory. The Monk stares at her, then at the churning Lattice, a revelation dawning.
lines_after.stage_directions: Lightning illuminates the Monk's face—conflict replaced by certainty.

lines_after.dialogue: A silent zone... a dead spot the charts hide. A sanctuary preserved by silence. I believe you can do it, brother. Guide us.
lines_after.stage_directions: Pichit looks from the desperate Kirin to the resolute Monk, his staff's pulse syncing with his heartbeat.

lines_after.dialogue: The charts are a cage! I've seen the edges of that silence from my platform. It's real. But getting there... the ship's nav-lock won't allow it. They've forbidden the course.
lines_after.stage_directions: Kirin pushes herself up, her leg's resonance stabilizing into a pained, steady hum.

lines_after.dialogue: So we go through the storm! The old way! What are we waiting for?
lines_after.stage_directions: Chanida points excitedly at the maelstrom of crystalline energy ahead, already moving toward the helm.

line.dialogue: Pichit! The choice is yours. My path is heresy—a blind descent using the storm's own resonance patterns, as the ancient Singers did. No charts, only the Lattice's raw song. The ship is not rated for it. The other path is through them.
line.stage_directions: He gestures to the secured bridge door, behind which the First Mate is regrouping. The storm howls.

choices.description: Malee attempts to use the leg as a lattice probe, relying on leg resonance

line.dialogue: Malee's expertise pays off. Malee's leg locks onto a buried harmonic node.
A costly mistake by Malee. The crystal core dims from resonance overload.

choices.description: Have Pichit risk using tonal knowledge to test the prosthetic reaction

line.dialogue: Pichit finds the key. The crystal core makes the lattice temporarily visible.
The gamble fails. His staff overheats, forcing him to drop it.

choices.description: Have the scavenger focus platform climbing on the cloud corridors to use the leg as a lattice probe

line.dialogue: the scavenger finds the key. The prosthetic glows with an unfamiliar color.
The lattice has other plans. A harmonic mismatch makes the prosthetic seize up.

lines_before.dialogue: The ship tears through the final veil of crystalline mist, and all sound ceases. Not a whisper, not a hum—just profound, absolute silence. Before them floats a pre-Silencing structure, its geometric lines both shattered and serene.
lines_before.stage_directions: The resonance drives go dark. The lattice's ambient hum disappears. A medical facility hangs in the stillness, glowing with dormant, soft light.

lines_before.dialogue: I'm happy to hear this silence. It's not empty—it's full of answers.
lines_before.stage_directions: Pichit grips his staff, its crystal tip dimmed. He looks at Kirin with steady hope.

lines_before.dialogue: This... this is a forgotten verse. A sanctuary of pure harmony. Could you speak more slowly, machine? Let us understand.
lines_before.stage_directions: The monk kneels, hands trembling as he traces a sigil of reverence in the air.

lines_before.dialogue: Are you going or not, Kirin? That thing's waiting for you! Look at it!
lines_before.stage_directions: Chanida bounces on her toes, pointing excitedly at the medical console.

lines_before.dialogue: Pristine pre-Silencing tech. No Tonal Order modifications. If this thing still works, it's worth more than every floating city combined.
lines_before.stage_directions: Malee runs a scanner over the hull, her eyes wide at the readings.

lines_before.dialogue: Stay alert. There's no one else here, but that doesn't mean safe. I've got a cramp in my calf from that landing, but I'm watching.
lines_before.stage_directions: Arthit keeps a hand on his weapon, scanning the silent structure for threats.

lines_before.dialogue: Kirin approaches the machine. Her prosthetic leg resonates softly, and the facility awakens—not with noise, but with light that flows like liquid music.
lines_before.stage_directions: Holographic logs bloom in the air. Images of Singers, of refuge, of a legacy thought lost.

lines_after.dialogue: The machine completes its work. Kirin stands taller, her pain gone. The ship's database glows with new cartography—routes uncharted by the Orders.
lines_after.stage_directions: Kirin's prosthetic now hums in perfect harmony with the facility. A star map of pure, ancient lattice frequencies shimmers on the main screen.

lines_after.dialogue: This changes everything. The Silencing wasn't the end—it was a fracture. And we're holding a piece of what was meant to survive.
lines_after.stage_directions: Pichit's staff pulses in time with the map's gentle light. He looks at his crew, a hard-won hope in his eyes.

lines_after.dialogue: I'm not a thief anymore. I'm... a successor. This map—it's not just directions. It's a testament. We have to decide what to do with it.
lines_after.stage_directions: Kirin places a hand on the console, her expression resolved. The weight of legacy rests on her shoulders.

lines_after.dialogue: Let's go! We've got real charts now—we can go anywhere! Think of the celebrations we could have in places no one's seen in ages!
lines_after.stage_directions: Chanida is already at the helm, fingers dancing over the newly downloaded coordinates.

line.dialogue: The dilemma: Pichit's final choice: do they share the discovered map and the truth about the Singers with the Tonal Orders (risking confiscation but potentially reforming them), or keep it secret for now, using it only for their own journey and sharing only with trusted allies like the Listeners?
line.stage_directions: Tense moment. The monk looks from the map to Pichit, awaiting the decision that will shape their future.

choices.description: Pichit channels monk wisdom toward the cloud corridors, hoping to harness harmonic feedback

line.dialogue: The gambit pays off. The ex-Listener's instincts prove sharper than any instrument.
Pichit fails. Pichit's focus breaks under pressure.

choices.description: Ask Malee to use the leg as a lattice probe, drawing on engineering

line.dialogue: The gamble succeeds. The crystal core makes the lattice temporarily visible.
Malee fails. Malee's engineering fails against lattice corruption.

choices.description: The monk uses recording crystals to test the prosthetic reaction near the cloud corridors

line.dialogue: the monk finds the key. The monk's meditation reveals a pattern in the lattice's song.
Defeat. His recording crystal shatters.

lines_before.dialogue: The Hanging Gardens of Mae Rim breathe with the slow pulse of agriculture. Wind rustles through terraced grain, water channels sing soft melodies, and crystal windchimes suspended from bamboo frames catch the breeze with gentle, random harmonies.
Listen to that… the Lattice below us hums in counterpoint to the irrigation songs. It’s not a charted melody. It feels… alive.
It feels like we’ve been walking for days. My feet are killing me. Can we rest by that waterfall? I swear, if I have to listen to Arthit’s ‘cautious route’ one more time…
The safe path is the one that gets us to the supply cache. The Scavenger’s directions were… vague. We shouldn’t stray.
Oh, relax. The only danger here is dying of boredom. Farms. More farms. And the thrilling subplot of someone’s missing crystal leg. Riveting.
There’s discovery in stillness, Malee. This place holds memories in its soil. The way the sound layers… it’s telling us something.

It’s telling me my girlfriend gets jealous. She thinks these long trips are just excuses. ‘Another ‘resonance anomaly,’ Chanida? Really?’ Don’t make me cry! I sprained my ankle last month just to get home faster!
A figure emerges from a stand of singing bamboo—the Surface scavenger, their face leathery, eyes sharp. They lean on a staff tipped with a dull resonator crystal.

lines_after.dialogue: You’re the ones asking about the old Listeners’ shed? The one that fell during the last big storm?
We were told you might have… recovered items from the surface below the gardens.
Might have. Surface isn’t a playground. That prosthetic you’re after—it’s not just scrap. It’s got a song in it. A wrong one.
A wrong song? Did it offend the crystal etiquette? Play a discordant note at the wrong party?
Laugh. The Lattice laughs back. You want it? It’s in the old root cellar. But the door’s resonance-locked. Key’s with the monk. He studies the windchimes. Thinks they’re prayers.

line.dialogue: The Scavenger points toward a distant terrace where a lone figure sits among the chiming crystals.

choices.line: Approach the monk directly and ask for the key. (Diplomacy)
choices.description: Press your palm flat against the resonating floor and feel which way the Lattice pulses strongest.

line.dialogue: Pichit — "The vibration flows east — that's where the current is healthiest. The cache lies with the current.
Pichit — "Nothing. Either I've gone deaf to it, or the Lattice has gone deaf to me.

choices.line: Have Chanida create a distraction near the windchimes while Pichit searches the monk’s belongings. (Stealth)
choices.description: Unbolt the corroded maintenance hatch marked with faded supply-route stencils.

line.dialogue: Arthit — "Stencil's a match for Cache 7-Alpha. Supply route codes don't lie — unlike the people who carved them.
Arthit — "The hinge crumbles. Whatever seal this hatch once held, something already broke it from the other side.

choices.line: Send Arthit to negotiate, citing official Tonal Order research permits. (Authority)
choices.description: Let Malee take point down the branching corridor where the windchimes fall silent.

line.dialogue: Malee — "See?
The attempt backfires on the scavenger. The spectral voice speaks only fragments.

lines_before.dialogue: The windchime terrace is a symphony of glass and bamboo. the Listener monk sits cross-legged, eyes closed, a data-slate resting on his knees. Each chime’s tone causes a corresponding glyph to flicker on the slate.
You’re mapping the natural harmonics… but you’re filtering out the dissonances. Why?
The Orders say dissonance is data corruption. Noise from the Silencing. But… these gaps in the song… it’s still in my memory. The complete melody, before the fracture.
We need access to the root cellar. The Scavenger said you have the resonator key.

That cellar… it’s not just storage. It’s a tomb for a failed experiment. The prosthetic leg inside—it was meant to harmonize a wearer with the Lattice. Instead, it amplified their pain. Their screams are etched in the crystal.
So it’s a haunted robo-leg? Great. What province is Hua Hin in? Because I’d rather be there.
Crying crystal limbs, monks with guilt complexes… it’s the latest fashion in pastoral horror, apparently.

Fashion? She still lives in my memory. The wearer. A singer who thought she could heal the Lattice’s wounds through her own body. The key… I hid it because the sound it makes to unlock the door… it’s her final, silent scream.

lines_after.dialogue: A memory given sound. That’s not corruption. That’s a truth the Orders buried.
Truth is a dangerous frequency. The key is inside the largest windchime—the one with the cracked blue crystal. But touching it will trigger the memory. You’ll hear her. You’ll feel it.
Is it safe? Psychic resonance feedback can cause neural scarring.
Safe? Nothing about the Lattice is safe. Only silent. And I am tired of silence.
The blue chime hangs slightly apart, its fracture catching the light. A faint, painful hum vibrates the air around it.

line.dialogue: The key is within reach, but shielded by a painful, resonant memory.

choices.line: Have Pichit, as a potential Singer, try to gently harmonize with and quiet the memory before retrieving the key. (Resonance)
choices.description: Force the cellar's resonance lock by matching the shattered hymn's frequency with your tuning fork.

line.dialogue: Pichit — "The harmonics align — hear that? The lock is singing open, the root cellar yields.
Pichit — "Wrong frequency — the lock screamed back at me, and now my ears are bleeding.

choices.line: Use a portable damper from the ship’s supplies to mute the crystal long enough to grab the key. (Technical)
choices.description: Invoke monastic dispensation to breach the cellar, citing the Order's doctrine on sacred tombs.

line.dialogue: Monk — "By the Third Versicle, I have authority — step aside, this tomb answers to me now.
Monk — "The dispensation was denied — the Order says I've strayed too far into heresy.

choices.line: Let Chanida take the brunt of the memory—her impulsive nature might let her power through the psychic shock to seize it. (Brute Force)
choices.description: Bribe the Scavenger with distilled resonance shards for the alternate tunnel entrance beneath the cellar.

line.dialogue: Arthit — "Shards accepted — the Scavenger's grinning, and the tunnel mouth is right behind the cistern.
Arthit — "He spat at my feet — says the shards are counterfeit, and now he's reaching for his blade.

lines_before.dialogue: The quiet of the Hanging Gardens is broken. The monk's confession hangs in the air, heavier than the evening mist.

The Tonal Orders... they didn't just lose the leg. They *took* it. From a Listener who discovered a frequency that could heal the Lattice itself. I did it all myself. I hid the schematics here, among the roots.
So the prosthetic isn't just a tool? It's a key? When did this conspiracy get here, right under our noses?
Of course. The monopoly controls the maps, so why not control the cure? He's not the one who did the taking, just the hiding. Typical.
This is far more dangerous than scavenging. If the Orders are actively suppressing this... possessing these schematics makes us targets.
A frequency to heal, not just navigate... It's the opposite of The Silencing. This changes everything we understand.
The surface whispers of old wounds in the crystal. If you've got a way to mend them... that's worth more than any salvage. But the Orders have ears everywhere, even up here.

lines_after.dialogue: The monk produces a small, resonant crystal shard from his robes—the data storage for the prosthetic's true design. It hums with a faint, warm light.
The choice is yours. The knowledge, and the danger that sings with it.
We can't unhear this song. We have to decide what to do with it.

line.dialogue: The party must decide how to proceed with the dangerous schematics.

choices.text: Copy the schematics secretly. Leave the original with the monk to divert risk.
choices.consequence: You gain the plans with minimal immediate danger, but the knowledge is fragmented.
choices.description: Examine the prosthetic's hidden compartment for engraved frequency coordinates, 15 words

line.dialogue: There — etched beneath the joint plate — coordinates that don't exist on any sanctioned map.
The mechanism is sealed with a tonal lock. I forced it and the whole leg started screaming.

choices.text: Take the crystal and seek a trusted Listener enclave to verify its song.
choices.consequence: You gain powerful allies, but you must travel openly, leaving a trace.
choices.description: Disguise yourselves as pilgrims and cross the Orders' checkpoint at the Resonance Gate, 15 words

line.dialogue: Keep your heads down and your mouths shut. We're beggars seeking the tone — nothing more.
The warden asked me to recite the Third Harmonic. I guessed wrong. We need to run — now.

choices.text: Take the crystal and prepare to use it. The Lattice's wound needs healing, not study.
choices.consequence: You commit to direct, radical action, making you a primary target for the Orders.
choices.description: Contact Malee's old smuggling contact who once mapped the forbidden sub-frequencies beneath the city, 15 words

line.dialogue: Jom still owes me for the Phra Khanong run. She'll get us below — but we pay in silence.
Jom's gone dark. Either the Orders got to her or someone worse did. Either way, that door is closed.

lines_before.dialogue: The decision is made. But as the crystal's song is activated for verification or preparation, its unique resonance pulses through the terraces. It's a beacon.
The peaceful sounds of water and wind are drowned by the dissonant hum of approaching Resonance Ships. The Tonal Orders have come to reclaim their secret.
They're here. I'm just surprised it took them this long. Our resonance signature must have been unique.
So much for a quiet retirement in the gardens. What do you think about making a stand among the cabbages?
They want to silence this song again? Over my dead resonator!
I know these terraces. The irrigation channels, the weak lattice patches... we can use the land itself. It's something to think about.
This is my fault. My fear let this fester. No more. The garden will bear witness to truth or silence.
This is the moment. Do we hide the seed of healing, or plant it and see what grows, no matter the storm?

lines_after.dialogue: The confrontation culminates not in sheer destruction, but in a resonant climax—a clash of frequencies over the Hanging Gardens.
The outcome determines whether the secret of the prosthetic is lost, secured, or unleashed into the world, its song echoing across the Floating Cities.
The Lattice heard us today. Every choice has a frequency. This was ours.

line.dialogue: The Orders' ships descend. How do you resolve the climax?

choices.text: Use the crystal's resonance to sabotage the garden's lattice, causing a controlled collapse to cover your escape.
choices.consequence: You escape with the crystal, but the Gardens are damaged, and the Orders believe the secret is lost.
choices.description: Flood the irrigation channels to separate the terraces and force them into a bottleneck.

line.dialogue: ** "The channels hold! They're funneled between the second and third terraces — exactly where the footing collapses to mud.
** "The gates are warped — won't seal. Water's dispersing everywhere, and now *we're* the ones slipping.

choices.text: Confront the lead Order agent. Challenge them to a public resonant duel, using the garden's natural acoustics as the arena.
choices.consequence: You win legitimacy and witnesses. The secret is exposed, sparking debate and rebellion across the cities.
choices.description: Have Chanida broadcast a counter-resonance through the garden's acoustic shells to disorient the approaching squad.

line.dialogue: ** "The shells amplify it perfectly. Listen — they're dropping formation, clutching their ears. The song refuses to be silenced.
** "The harmonics are wrong — the shells are cracking, and the feedback is hitting *us* instead. My ears are ringing.

choices.text: Sync the prosthetic's frequency with the heart of the Gardens. Attempt an immediate, localized healing of the Lattice for all to see.
choices.consequence: You risk everything. Success could heal the land and shatter the Order's authority. Failure could cause a second, small-scale Silencing.
choices.description: Use the garden's dense canopy cover to slip

line.dialogue: the scavenger succeeds. A crystal fragment resonates with the environment.
The lattice has other plans. The echo fades to silence.

lines_before.dialogue: The Resonance Ship docks with a shuddering hum, its crystal resonators powering down. Outside the viewport, the Harmonic Perch clings to the Lattice like a barnacle on a frozen ocean of crystal. The platform groans underfoot, a symphony of stressed metal and subliminal vibration.
lines_before.stage_directions: The docking bay is dim, lit by flickering phosphor-lamps. Strange instruments line the walls, their needles twitching to silent frequencies.

lines_before.dialogue: The silence here... it's not silent at all. I can't keep up with what you're saying, Lattice. Too many whispers.
lines_before.stage_directions: Pichit presses a hand against the cold viewport, his staff's crystal glowing faintly in response to the ambient resonance.

lines_before.dialogue: Papers. Now. Official travel permits from a Tonal Order House. Let's see your driver's license.
lines_before.stage_directions: The Scavenger emerges from shadow, face obscured by a grit-stained rebreather. He holds out a gloved hand, not bothering to look at their faces.

lines_before.dialogue: Driver's license? We're on a crystal sea, not a road! Why couldn't you just ask normally?
lines_before.stage_directions: Chanida steps forward, hands on her hips, clearly annoyed by the brusque welcome.

lines_before.dialogue: Standard procedure for independent platforms. He thinks we're smugglers. Or worse, auditors.
lines_before.stage_directions: Malee sighs, already rummaging through her pack for their forged documents. Her eyes scan the equipment with professional interest.

lines_before.dialogue: Easy. We're just researchers. Studying anomalous frequencies.
lines_before.stage_directions: Arthit positions himself slightly between the Scavenger and the rest of the party, his posture relaxed but ready.

lines_before.dialogue: Before the Scavenger can respond, the docking hatch hisses open again. A new figure enters, his robes impeccably clean amidst the grime.
lines_before.stage_directions: The Merchant smiles, his eyes missing nothing. The Scavenger visibly tenses.

lines_after.dialogue: The tremor passes, leaving a profound silence in its wake. The Scavenger's monitors erupt with frantic data. He turns to the party, his earlier suspicion replaced by something more urgent.
lines_after.stage_directions: He yanks a cloth cover from a nearby workbench, revealing a crystalline shard about the length of a forearm. It pulses with a soft, internal light.

lines_after.dialogue: That frequency... it's the same as the pulse. But cleaner. Older.
lines_after.stage_directions: Pichit's staff hums in sympathetic resonance, the crystal at its tip blazing to life.

lines_after.dialogue: Fascinating! A pre-Silencing artifact? The Tonal Orders would pay a fortune for such a find. Or perhaps... better clients exist.
lines_after.stage_directions: The Merchant's smile doesn't reach his eyes. He takes a step closer, calculating the shard's worth.

lines_after.dialogue: He's hiding it from them. Why? What does it do?
lines_after.stage_directions: Chanida points accusingly at the Merchant, then at the shard, already moving to get a better look.

line.dialogue: It sings a pattern. A warning, maybe. The Orders would lock it away or break it down for parts. You seem... different. Do you want to see the real message? Or do we let our 'friend' here call his contacts?
line.stage_directions: The Scavenger places a protective hand near the shard, his eyes locked on Pichit. The Merchant's friendly facade slips, revealing cold expectation.

choices.description: Pull out the rusted harmonic tuning fork and strike it against the platform railing, filling the air with a resonant chord that makes the scavenger's permit papers vibrate visibly. 15 words

line.dialogue: The fork doesn't lie — that frequency is my signature, registered with the Order's eastern choir since before you learned to read.
That sound... that's not my note. That's the perch itself answering back, and I don't think it likes you any more than I do.
